items.why: Fear gauge is unwinding as the AI trade rebounds: Nasdaq and S&P are rising Monday and the chip rout is losing steam, per the market wrap headlines.
Intel and AMD rose about 4% after JPMorgan upgraded Intel following a steep pullback, sparking a rebound in beaten-down chip names.
Megacap tech is riding the rebound as Wall Street calls the latest AI selloff just another scare, with the Nasdaq leading Monday higher.
Rising with the broader tape as investors buy the dip on Monday despite lingering fear the AI trade's nightmare scenario is not over.

market_note: Monday open: NQ=F +1.25%, ES=F +0.5%, ^VIX -9.9%, oil -1.5%, gold -0.1%.
summary: The AI trade is rebounding Monday morning as investors buy the dip after last week's tech rout, with Nasdaq futures up 1.25% and the VIX down nearly 10%. AMD is leading chip names higher on a JPMorgan upgrade to Intel.
